notes: Alpaca corporate actions are first-seen observations; provider event dates are never substituted for collector availability.
A no-action interval passes only when the Alpaca ledger covers the interval after maturity and an archived official Vanguard schedule independently shows no scheduled VOO distribution date inside it.
An interval crossing a distribution remains blocked until the per-share amount and dates are independently verified; an Alpaca-only amount is not called verified total return.
Cash distribution entitlement is included in holding-period value without assuming an unobserved reinvestment fill.
